title: Art in The Park
summary: On the last Sunday of every month the Hermanus Art Circle holds an art exhibition at the Hermanus Cricket Grounds, with all the art on offer for sale.
description:
Art in the Park is a new initiative of the Hermanus Art Circle. 

On the last Sunday of every month an art exhibition will be held at the Hermanus Cricket Grounds, to create an artistic and fun evening. Food and drinks will also be available whilst all the art on offer will be for sale! Stalls are R100 each.

For more info please contact HAC (http://www.hermanus.co.za/where-to-buy/arts-culture-a-heritage/art-galleries/5124-hermanus-art-circle)
profile: Art in the Park, by the Hermanus Art Circle, is an art exhibition and sale at the Hermanus Cricket Grounds on the last Sunday of every month, with food and drinks available. Visitors browse and buy local art. It suits art lovers; the calendar entry dates from 2015 and may be out of date.

title: Hermanuspietersfontein Food & Wine Market
summary: Every Saturday the Hermanuspietersfontein Kos & Wynmark is opened at the Wine Village opposite Sandbaai.
description: Every Saturday the Hermanuspietersfontein Kos & Wynmark is opened at the Wine Village opposite Sandbaai. All the food is freshly made with loving care. Enjoy a great meal at one of the many seating areas on the lawn or mingle with the crowds. For more information you can contact Anike de Goede on 072-3528046
profile: The Hermanuspietersfontein Food & Wine Market opens every Saturday morning at the Wine Village opposite Sandbaai, with freshly made food. Visitors eat at seating areas on the lawn and mingle with the crowds. It suits food and wine lovers; the calendar entry dates from 2008 and may be out of date.

title: Wine Club Monthly Meeting
summary: Every month the Wine Village hosts an evening to wine and dine amongst friends and enthusiasts, with hand-picked wines, talks and discussions.
description:
Every month the Wine Village hosts a great evening that gives you the chance to wine and dine amongst friends and enthusiasts. The evenings always feature a select number of hand picked wines whilst talks and discussions are also given.

You can choose to subscribe yearly at R300 p/person per year or you may pay on entrance (R30 p/person).

For more information please contact the wine village:
028 316 3988 or winevillage@hermanus.co.za
profile: The Wine Village's monthly wine club evening on the 1st of the month, featuring a selection of hand-picked wines with talks and discussions. Guests pay R30 at the door or subscribe for the year. It suits wine enthusiasts; the calendar entry dates from 2014 and may be out of date.

title: Hermanus Country Market
summary: Every Saturday morning a unique outdoor deli experience, where you can buy good, wholesome, local fresh produce, direct from the source.
description: Please come and join us this and every Saturday morning to enjoy a unique outdoor deli experience, where you can buy good, wholesome, local fresh produce, direct from the source. 072 883 3894
profile: The Hermanus Country Market as listed on the town calendar: an outdoor deli market every Saturday morning selling wholesome local fresh produce direct from the source. Visitors shop and eat. The calendar entry dates from 2008–2011 and gives the Hermanus Montessori School as the venue, which may be out of date.

title: Weekly Tours of SANSA
summary: Every Wednesday visitors can enjoy a free tour of the SANSA Centre, including the SANSA Space Weather Centre where solar activity is monitored.
description:
Every Wednesday visitors can enjoy a free tour of the SANSA Centre, including a visit to the SANSA Space Weather Centre where solar activity is monitored. You're also able to visit the Tech Unit and Science Centre, which help to explain the complex approaches that SANSA takes to monitor the stars and more.

For more information please contact SANSA on 028 312 1196 or email them via spacesci-info@sansa.org.za
profile: A free weekly Wednesday tour of the SANSA Space Science centre in Hermanus, including the Space Weather Centre where solar activity is monitored, the Tech Unit and the Science Centre. Visitors learn how SANSA monitors space. It suits curious visitors of all ages; the calendar entry dates from 2015 and may be out of date.

title: First Fridays Artwalk
summary: On the first Friday of every month the art galleries in Hermanus Village centre remain open until 8pm for the Hermanus First Fridays Artwalk.
description:
On the first Friday of every month we showcase our towns wealth of fine art with "Hermanus First Fridays Artwalk"; an ideal opportunity to visit Hermanus Village centre as the twelve art galleries remain open to welcome you until 8pm. Stroll through the village, savour a glass of wine from one of our local vineyards and enjoy the astonishing range of art and fine craft on display.

Enjoy over 300 artists, 4000 paintings and 200 sculptures and ceramics whilst you walk the town at twilight!

For more information please call 083 259 8869 or email originals@hermanus.co.za
profile: Hermanus First Fridays Artwalk: on the first Friday of every month the village galleries stay open until 8pm. Visitors stroll between galleries with a glass of local wine and see paintings, sculpture, ceramics and fine craft. It suits art lovers.

title: Fisherman's Village Craft Market
summary: A craft market at Lemm's Corner every Sunday.
profile: The Fisherman's Village Craft Market at Lemm's Corner, listed on the town calendar every Sunday from 08:30 to 15:00. Visitors browse craft stalls. The entry has no description and dates from 2008, so it may be out of date.

title: Cupcake & Tea Garden
summary: The Cupcake & Tea Garden is open to all every Friday from 09h30 - 11h30, with nibbles, treats, tea and coffee.
description:
The Cupcake & Tea Garden is once again open to all every Friday from 09h30 - 11h30. There are some great nibbles and treats for everyone to enjoy, as well as tea and coffee.

For more information please contact Marie on 083-4571896
profile: A tea garden at 55 Berg Street in Onrus, open to all every Friday morning with nibbles, treats, tea and coffee. Visitors stop in for tea. It suits anyone wanting a quiet morning cuppa.

title: The Hermanus Country Market
summary: A small market with a lot of soul. Where good friends meet, eat, and buy beautiful things...
description:
A small market with a lot of soul. Where good friends meet, eat, and buy beautiful things...
An amazing array of fresh organic produce, homemade delicacies, artisan breads, probiotic yoghurts, handmade cheeses, home smoked fish, happy hen eggs, wheat-free bakes, a whole variety of arts & crafts, as well as live music, plants and all things that are good for your health and happiness!
The market has been going strong since 2006, and has now moved to the wonderful setting of the Hermanus Cricket Club. The traders all come from the greater Overstrand area, giving the market a truly local feel. The market organisers and the traders try as best we can to run the market according to eco-friendly principles, and we are committed to creating a wholesome experience with a minimal impact on the environment.
Come and join us every Saturday between 08:00 and 12:00 and Wednesday from 16:00 till 20:00 in the evening at the Hermanus Cricket Club for some feel-good fun.
For more information contact the Hermanus Country Market or visit their site.
PLEASE NOTE: The Evening Market will only be open from the 10th December 2014 until the 14th January 2015 - excluding the 24th December 2014
profile: The Hermanus Country Market at the Hermanus Cricket Club every Saturday morning, running since 2006 with organic produce, artisan breads, cheeses, smoked fish, baked goods, arts and crafts, plants and live music from Overstrand traders. Visitors shop and eat at an eco-minded local market. It suits families and food lovers; the page's Wednesday evening market ran only in 2014–2015.
